title: Странное настроение Шефа  (The Chef's Strange Mood)

segments.t: In the staff corridor, Senya and Fedya trade guesses about what was said the night before, right until Chef Barinov storms past yelling at them to get back to work. Fedya declares he is tired of guessing what is wrong with the Chef and decides he is simply crazy.
Я не понял, девочки, вы что, на гособеспечении?
Я уже задолбался угадывать, что с ним.
Давай примем, что он просто псих.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.

'Did you tell her yesterday?' By asking whether Fedya tells her yesterday, Senya presses Fedya for a straight answer. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
'I told her...' Over the situation and the room, Fedya answers Senya without a second thought.
'Sun. Transformer.' Between the situation and the room, Senya gives Fedya a quick, grounded response.

'Wait, what did he even say?' Here asking what he even say shows Fedya looking for the real truth. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'Oh, what a guy.' With the situation and kitchen in play, Senya keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
'Something about love, probably.' Over the situation and the kitchen, Fedya answers Senya without a second thought.
Я не понял, девочки, вы что, на гособеспечении?

'I do not get it, girls, are you on state welfare or what?' Senya asks whether he does not get it girls are Fedya on state welfare, refusing to let the point slide. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.

'Get to work fast, you stumps!' Telling Senya to get to work fast Senya stumps is Fedya's blunt reaction in front of Senya. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
'What is wrong with him today?' By asking what wrong with him today is, Senya presses Fedya for a straight answer.
Я уже задолбался угадывать, что с ним.
'I am sick and tired of guessing what is wrong with him.' Here being sick and tired of guessing what is wrong with him sets up the next turn in their exchange.
Давай примем, что он просто псих.

'Let us just accept that he is simply nuts.' Since they should just accept that he is simply nuts, Senya does not waste words on excuses. Starting with "davay" is the everyday Russian way to say "come on, let us do this".
'Go knock on your own head.' Admitting that Senya should go knock on Senya's own head shows Fedya being honest for a change. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.
Я не понял, девочки, вы что, на гособеспечении?
Я уже задолбался угадывать, что с ним.
Давай примем, что он просто псих.
That wraps up this scene as in the locker room and kitchen corridor, Senya and Fedya try to figure out why Chef Barinov is barking orders and acting even crazier than usual. Until next time!
